title: Canonical internal projection-formula helper maps
statement: For a pro-etale morphism of schemes with condensed commutative coefficient sheaf, use the published internal-module projection-formula interface: `ModuleObjectTensorGeneratorFormula` specifies the ordinary balanced tensor comparison on pure tensors; `ModuleObjectDerivedTensorFormula` specifies its total-complex lift and derived counit normalization; `existsUnique_moduleObjectDerivedTensorComparison` gives the unique comparison satisfying these formulas and invertibility; `moduleObjectDerivedTensorComparison` is that comparison; and `moduleObjectProjectionMate` is the counit mate of this comparison under the recorded derived upper-star/lower-star adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. The ambient internal-module categories and maps use [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], [def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction], and [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate].

lean.statement:
def moduleObjectProjectionMate
    (A : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)))
    (B : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y))) :
    (lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj A ⊗ B ⟶
      (lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        (A ⊗ (upperStar Λ f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj B)
lean.note: Existing published declarations in Sheaf.Paper.RationalLocalizingProjectionFormula.lean. They are the five canonical helper definitions used by the projection/exchange module; the stronger theorem det-thm-sf-pf-field-localizing is not cited.
